title: Study 5 PPS box-breathing white/pink profile
citation: PPS Toolkit Study 5 white/pink protocol (2026). Box-breathing audio-tactile PPS profile with white and pink looming sources. Unpublished lab profile.
notes: Local unpublished Study 5 preload using white and pink frontal looming burst sources. This is the canonical Study 5 profile in this repository. It retains the Study 5 timing, SOA, stationary-burst baseline, catch, instruction, trajectory, block, and participant defaults, and scales Segment 4 family repetitions for the two-source pool so the prepared trial pool preserves 204 rows and six 34-trial blocks.

reference_parameters.noise_source_policy: Canonical Study 5 source pool: Pink frontal and White frontal only. Segment 4 family repetitions are scaled to audio-tactile 6.0, baseline 3.0, and catch 6.0 so the prepared trial pool preserves 204 rows and six 34-trial blocks.
reference_parameters.source_pool_profile_note: The repository retains only the white/pink Study 5 source pool as the canonical Study 5 profile.

provenance.source: Bundled owned Study 5 breathing instruction WAVs include both assets/breathing/british_kokoro generated with Kokoro ONNX using the British English bf_emma voice and assets/breathing/original_study5 decoded from the original local Study 5 instruction MP3s. The default Study 5 preload now uses the original Study 5 inhale/exhale clips, while the British Kokoro pair remains available as an alternate fixed-audio source.

Bundled owned Study 5 auditory-only looming WAVs under assets/preloads/study5_box_breathing_pps/02_looming_stimuli; the preload inventory records the white/pink generated-noise recipe, trajectory metadata, segment catalog paths, and SHA-256 hashes.

Local Study 5 dashboard workflow uses within-block trial type rows: Inhale instruction | Looming Stimulus and Exhale instruction | Looming Stimulus. Rows are logged as trial_type_label values and scheduled sequentially top-to-bottom inside each block.
Study 5 toolkit defaults: 110 cm to 10 cm approach, 3 s movement inside a 4 s stimulus window, SOAs 300/800/1500/2200/2700 ms.

provenance.value: White/pink canonical Study 5 source pool with Segment 4 repetitions scaled to audio-tactile 6.0, baseline 3.0, and catch 6.0.
The white/pink canonical Study 5 profile scales Segment 4 family repetitions to audio-tactile 6.0, baseline 3.0, and catch 6.0 so the 204-row Study 5 trial budget is retained.
